description: Fixture-backed music catalog: search tracks, set now playing, list playlists, and add tracks to playlists.

capability_notes.summary: Track search matches query terms against title, artist, and album in the fixture only; there is no live streaming catalog or network call.
Playing a track replaces now_playing with that track id and a deterministic narrative started_at.
Adding to a playlist appends the track id (duplicates allowed); missing playlist or track ids return 404.
